Package com.kerosene.kfe.wallet.adapters.in.observation

Class KfeCustodialDepositObservationService

java.lang.Object
com.kerosene.kfe.wallet.adapters.in.observation.KfeCustodialDepositObservationService
@Service @ConditionalOnProperty(name="kfe.custodial-deposit-observation.enabled", havingValue="true", matchIfMissing=true) public class KfeCustodialDepositObservationService extends Object
Detects external on-chain deposits into KfeWalletKind.CUSTODIAL_ONCHAIN addresses (e.g. Electrum → custodial receive address) and credits the internal ledger.

Policy: as soon as the tx is seen on the network (mempool / 0-conf), create an inbound row with status VALIDATING (UI badge PENDING), notify the user, and publish dashboard/WS so the recipient app updates immediately. available_sats is credited only when confirmations reach minConfirmations.

Without this, only payment-request inbounds credit available_sats. Random chain deposits only moved observed_sats, so the app balance looked stuck.
